notes: M.G.L. c. 186 § 11 sets a 14-day notice to quit for nonpayment of rent under a written lease, a tenant's right to cure by paying all rent due with interest and costs by the answer date, and a continuance when government payment delays caused the nonpayment. These provisions govern how a tenancy is ended (notice period, cure and timing). They do not require a just cause or otherwise limit whether a landlord may end the tenancy, so they are out of scope and no rule was extracted.
